text.name: description
text.data: Hollow rectangular link frames and centered joint cages; explicit body mass, CoM and full inertia preserved from the initial solid-prism concept. L1 includes the base height.

text.name: length_definitions
text.data: L1: floor to J2; L2: J2-J3; L3: J3-J4; L4: J4-J5; L5: J5-J6; L6: J6-TCP

text.name: mass_properties
text.data: Explicit inertial elements define body mass, local CoM and inertia. All visible geoms have zero mass and contacts disabled; changing visual rod thickness does not change dynamics.
